reviews.title: Blood sugar?
reviews.text: I could record my sugar, but not find out what is is without poking my finger. Ad is misleading. I will cancel this now.

reviews.title: FALSE ADVERTISING
reviews.text: This app is FALSE in what it states that offers. It DOES NOT measure sugar levels as it shows and advertises on the website. FALSE

reviews.title: 心拍数しか測れない
reviews.text: 皆さんがおっしゃる通り血圧等は測れない。

reviews.title: False advertising as free when there is a monthly charge
reviews.text: Should be forced to be truthful

reviews.title: NO BLOOD PRESSURE/GLUCOSE
reviews.text: Currently, there is no device on a smart phone that can read your blood pressure and your glucose level. You must measure your BP & Glucose on another device. Given the readings, you can only enter the values into a diary. This is so deceiving. Buyer beware!

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text: The add show reading heart rate and blood sugar. It only shows the heart rate. You have to put in the blood sugar. Another disappointing app.  But I gave it a try only to be let down yet again.

reviews.title: 血糖値はかれません
reviews.text: 血圧のみ。あとは何かで測定して記録できるだけ。自分で入力。

reviews.title: 詐欺
reviews.text: 血糖値は測れない上に、1週間で1000円と出てきます。ダウンロードしない方が良いです。

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I was only able to do my heart rate and nothing else.  I tried to add except it said wasn’t measured I even tapped measure. Nothing No directions except for the heart rate.

reviews.title: Estafa
reviews.text: Te dice que es gratis y que puedes hacerlo pero te cobra no te deja 😒 deberían decir que si cobraran

reviews.title: 解約してください
reviews.text: 画面転換も出来ず、やめたいと思います。課金される前に解約してください。さもなくば訴えます。
